description: This file declares the FrontPanel class, which is a plugin component for the WPEFramework. It manages front panel controls such as LED indicators, brightness, clock display, and test patterns. It includes method declarations for control operations, wrappers for JSON-RPC communication, and internal state management.

classes.name: TestPatternInfo
classes.description: A helper class to manage and compare test pattern states for the front panel.

classes.name: FrontPanel
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing front panel controls, JSONRPC interface, and plugin lifecycle management.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the front panel lights.

methods.name: powerLedOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified front panel indicator LED.

methods.name: powerLedOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified front panel indicator LED.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Returns a list of available front panel lights.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about front panel lights.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences for front panel settings.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets user preferences for front panel.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Configures LED properties based on provided JSON properties.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Controls blinking behavior of front panel lights.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures clock display format to 24 hours.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if 24-hour clock format is enabled.

methods.name: setClockTestPattern
methods.description: Enables or disables clock test pattern display.

methods.name: powerModeChange
methods.description: Callback for power mode change events.
